comment: Thinning rule: tracked non-product surface may only shrink. First match wins in `order`. Slash-less globs match the basename at any depth; globs with `/` match the full repo-relative path. P (product) is the untaxed fallback. D (evidence data) may never add files or bytes. G/E additions above target must remove >= offsetRatio x added bytes from the SAME bucket. pinBan forbids pinning binary SHAs or source line citations in added lines only. Exceptions exempt matching paths from the NAMED rule only; expired exceptions do not apply and are themselves a violation until removed.

rules.dGrowth: D may not add files or bytes at all (governed by rule d-growth, not by offset).
rules.offset: While a bucket with targetBytes is above its target, added bytes must be matched by >= offsetRatio x removed bytes from the SAME bucket.
rules.pinBan: Added lines (diff vs base) in pinBan paths must not contain a 64-hex sha256 next to a .glb/.png/.py/.npz path, nor a <file>.py:<line> / .ts:<line> citation.
